header_sentences: See Brain, Mind, Soul, and Spirit.

contexts.text: All things from the Lord... have a kind of body, here signified by moving itself, or creeping.
Under Beast, see this reference.
Man... is a spirit clothed with a body.
After the death of the body... AC 1757.
They suppose they are still living in the body... AC 320. AC 1376. AC 4622:4. SE 296. SE 352. SE 690. SE 1243. SE 1775. SE 2330. SE 2775.
He had placed life in the body...
The soul or spirit is in its own body.
The body only serves man for living on earth... and never lives or thinks.
The spirit in man feels, not the body.
As in the human body everything contributes to uses... so in the Lord's Kingdom...
They likened man's body to the earth, or ground, as here, where earth = the outward man.
Some (Spirits punished) as to the whole body.
Inducing on the Spirits as it were bodies. AC 969:end.

That the body and its Sensual and faculty of pleasure is not the outward man is evident from the fact that Spirits who have no body such as that they had in the world, have an outward man all the same.
When in thought he is withdrawn from the body...
As in the human body, everything is of use.
The Word's outward sense is like a body. AC 2311.
However he turns his body...
Heaven... is like the body...
Spirits, as to the organic things which constitute their bodies, are not where they are seen...
Wandering Spirits are like the fluids in the human body.

As soon as the mind departs from bodily things, those of the soul become evident. This is the reason why not only bodily things must die before a man can be regenerated, but also that the body itself must die in order that he may come into Heaven... But the things of the sense of the letter are like those with man in his body, namely, the scientifics of the memory which are from sensuous things...
With Him alone was the correspondence of all things of the body with the Divine most perfect...
What lives with man is not the body, but the soul, and the body lives through the soul. AC 2311. AC 2475.
The body is only as it were a covering or shell which is dissolved for man to truly live...
With the Lord all is Jehovah... even the very body, wherefore He alone rose... with the body. Illustrated. AC 2083.
As in the human body, which comes forth and subsists through its soul; wherefore everything in the body is representative of its soul; the latter is in use and end, the body in the exercise of them.
The exterior man or body itself is from the mother. AC 2005.
Man there retains everything except the body, which hinders the interior use of his faculties.
What is meant by being withdrawn from the body. AC 1883, Explained. HH 440, Explained.
In complete wakefulness of my body...
Preface. [3]. While with the body I am in the world, with the spirit I am in the other life, for man is a spirit clothed with a body. AC 3342:2. AC 4364:4.
The life of the affection of cognitions and scientifics gives to the Rational as it were a body, or clothes the life of the inward man as the body the soul.
While man lives in the body... AC 1984. AC 2367. AC 2500. AC 2994. AC 3195. AC 3212:3. AC 3293:end. AC 3314:end. AC 4249:2. AC 4280. AC 4423.
The Lord made Divine... even the interior and the exterior Sensual, thus the very body.
Pleasure is properly of the body...
When he puts off the body... AC 3342:end.
Whether you say the Divine Human, or the body, flesh, bread, or Divine Love, it is the same.
However men are infested as to the body, (the Angels) rate it as nothing relatively to the soul.
The exterior memory is proper to the body...

The exterior things of man are of his body... They are all like a body, or what is the same, a covering or clothing... The exteriors (of the Angels) are represented in both their bodies and clothing...
Exterior things cannot enter into interior, as composites into simples, thus the things of the body into those of the spirit, but contrariwise.
Only their bodies are black...
While man is in the body, as to the spirit he lives in Heaven, and as to the body in the world...
All parts of the human body correspond to Societies in Heaven... AC 2996. AC 3021. AC 4223. AC 4779. HH 212.
The soul of the body is its spirit, for from this the body lives.

With those who are in celestial and spiritual love, good from the Lord inflows through the soul into the body. Thus the body becomes light. But with those who are in bodily and worldly love, good from the Lord cannot inflow through the soul into the body, but their interiors are in darkness. Hence also the body becomes dark ().
Thus the Angels... know everything which is in the body.
The body is only the covering of man's spirit.
It is contrary to order for what is posterior to flow into what is prior, thus the body into the soul.
The outward man, that is, the things of the body.
Good is clothed with truth as with a tender body.
His body, and the bread = love to the Lord.
What is nearer to the world and the body cannot be easily reduced to serve the inward man...
The soul is enclosed in a tender body (in the womb)... So in regeneration... The tender body in which that soul is enclosed is the Natural and good there...
Under Atmosphere, see this reference.
Under Heart, see this reference, and at AC 3887:2. AC 3888. AC 3889.
All position there is relative to the human body. Explained. SE 1701.
As to his body he is a little world.
The spirit, after being loosed from bodily things is that very purified body which many say they will have at the time of the last judgment... That Spirits... are endowed with a body... AC 4527:2.
His body = His Divine love, and the reciprocal with man, such as is love with the celestial Angels.
The Human itself consists... also of the body, which served the Natural as a medium or outermost organ of living in the world, and through this the Rational, and through this the Divine.
(Variety and unity) in the human body. Described. AC 5598:2. AC 9613. AR 66. AR 73.
Spirits are distinguished according to their influx into parts of the body...
The body (in the Holy Supper) = Divine good. References.

They who know the inward sense know that they will come into the other life with a body, but a purer one, for there are purer bodies there, for they see each other, converse together, and enjoy every sense more excellently than in the body. The body which man carries about on earth is for uses there, and therefore consists of bones and flesh, and the body which a Spirit carries about... is for uses there, and does not consist of bones and flesh, but of such things as correspond to them. AC 4364:4.
Under Appetite, see this reference.
Although I was (in Heaven) I was not out of myself, but in the body, for Heaven is in man... So when it pleases the Lord, a man can be in Heaven, yet not withdrawn from the body.
All the Societies... act as one, as do all things in the body, although so various.
The body () means a carcase, for it is a dead body that is understood, and = the Church (devoid of the life of charity and of faith).
Under Anxiety, see this reference.

Nourishment has for its end that there be a sound mind in a sound body. If a man deprives his body of its nourishment, he also deprives himself of the state which is the end; wherefore, a spiritual man does not despise nourishment or pleasures...

When man puts off the body, he enjoys much brighter understanding than while he lived in the body, because while he is in the body, bodily and worldly thoughts occupy his attention, and these induce obscurity. But when the body is put off, such things do not interpose themselves...
Unless the correspondence of the inward man with the outward is effected in the life of the body, it is never effected.
On the one hand the Natural communicates with the sensuous things of the body...
Under Brain, see this reference, and at AC 4042. AC 4054.
Gilead, being a boundary = the first good, which is of the sensuous things of the body, for it is the good or pleasure of these into which the man who is being regenerated is first of all initiated.
If not in the life of the body... in the other life.
All things of the body represent those of the mind, and of the mind. Enumerated.

Truths and goods, as to both generals and particulars, are in Heaven arranged in this order, that one regards another in such a form, as do the members, organs, and viscera of the human body, or the uses of them...
The body itself and the things of the body... are relatively the most general things... Explained.
The body an instrument or material organ. AC 5948.
The life which is in the body is not of the body, but of the soul, that is, through the soul from the Lord, and yet it appears to be of the body...
To what province of the body Spirits belong, it has been given me to know from their position with me. AC 5171, (Under Province, see this reference.) AC 10379.
It is the Spirit which lives in the body...
Under Resurrection, see these references. AC 4783:4. AC 5078:3. HH 312:2.
Thus the body is an organ composed of all the most secret things in nature... and according to their secret forces and wonderful methods of flowing...

Some... on the same day their bodies were entombed saw their own corpse through my eyes... and said that they rejected it, and that it had served them for uses in the world in which they had been, and that now they live in a body which serves them for uses in the world in which they now are... AC 4652:end. AC 5078:3.

The sensitive power which appears in the body is properly of the spirit, and is of the body only through influx... It is not the body which sees, hears, smells, feels, but the spirit; wherefore when the spirit is rid of the body it is in its own sensations in which it had been in the body, and in fact in far keener ones... AC 4652.
Truth is in doctrine as the soul in its body.
They are sad that anything should be taken away from the body.

The spirit is the internal of man and the body his external... (From this it) might be supposed that the spirit dwells within the body, and that the body as it were girds and invests it, but the spirit of man is in the whole and every part of the body, and is its purer substance, in both its motor and sensory organs and everywhere else, and the body is what is material everywhere annexed to it, adapted to the world in which it then is.
As the body or outward man grows old, the spirit passes into newness of life...

(Although) it is the spirit which thinks in the body, and from which is the life of the body... yet so long as the spirit remains in the body, it can think only from the principles which the natural man has imbued, and when the principle and persuasion is that only the body lives... the influx of the above-named fact is not received.
In Heaven there are those who relate to all the provinces of the body, both exterior and interior.
When Societies operate they act into those parts of the body to which they correspond...
The butler and baker = the external sensuous things which are of the body...

The external senses, or those of the body, are five... and these constitute the whole Vital of the body, for without them the body would not live at all, wherefore when it is deprived of them, it dies and becomes a corpse; therefore the very Corporeal of man is nothing but a receptacle of sensations, consequently of life from them...

The exterior things of the Natural are what are properly called corporeal, or sensuous things of both kinds together with their receptacles; the latter with the former constitute what is called the body. The Lord made the Corporeal in Himself Divine, both its sensuous things and their receptacles, wherefore He rose... with the body.

These things are said that it may be known that no man rises with the body with which he was encompassed in the world; but the Lord alone, and this because He glorified His body or made it Divine while He was in the world.
It is a fallacy... that only the body lives.
The spirit can subsist without the material body... The body is in a more exterior degree.
Many learned men believe life to be in the body.
With those not being regenerated, these changes of state take place from causes in the body. Enumerated.

He who does not suffer himself to be regenerated loves the things of the body for the body's sake. But he who is being regenerated also loves the things of the body, but for the sake of a higher end, (namely) that there may be a sound mind in a sound body...
The second Heaven relates to the body. AC 6436. HH 29. TCR 608.
(The Spirits of the urinary organs) desire to introduce themselves into the body...
As to the body I remained in the same place. HH 192. References.
At this day men are in the body...
The internals are not permitted to flow into the solid parts of the body...

If man had lived the life of good... then when his body could no longer minister to his inward man... he would have passed without disease out of his earthly body into such a body as the Angels have, thus immediately into Heaven. SE 2542. SE 4592.
Scientifics are as it were their body...
The Spirits with man... are not adjoined to his body. (Under Action, see this reference.)
A certain evil Spirit was let into the state of the body by his thinking from the sensuous things of the body... He afterwards said that he supposed he was in the life of the body.

Man should take every care of his body, to nourish it, to clothe it, to let it enjoy the delights of the world; but all these things not for the sake of the body, but in order that the soul in a sound body may act correspondently and rightly, and may have the body as an organ perfectly obedient to it... AC 6936. NJHD 98.
Spirits who are to be called corporeal... appeared before the eyes of my spirit as in a gross body...
Intercourse of the soul with the body. General article.
Through the body the soul acts into the world, and enables the body to live.
All things in the Spiritual World and thence in the natural world seek for something ulterior in which to be... This ulterior thing is as a body.
Life from (riches, honours, and pleasures) is the life of the body... which perishes with the body.
Body () = a receptacle of good.

In the genuine sense, body = the good of love... The reason is that the body, or the whole man who is meant by the body, is a receptacle of life from the Lord, thus a receptacle of good, for the good of love constitutes the very life in man...

That body = the good of love, is also evident from the Angels, from whom... love pours forth so that you would believe they were nothing else, and this from their whole bodies; their bodies also appear resplendent and full of light from the light thence derived... Hence it is evident what is meant by the Lord's body, namely, Divine love... For the Lord's very body, when glorified... is nothing else.
Hence body in the Holy Supper = the Lord's Divine love towards the universal human race.
Divine love is also signified by the Lord's body in, He spake of the temple of His body (). Temple of body = Divine truth from Divine good.
As in the supreme sense, body = Divine good of His Divine love, all in Heaven are said to be in His body. HH 81.
Under Beryl, see this reference.
(How the bodies of Saul, etc. were occupied by Spirits, shown by experience.)
Spirits occupied the bodies of the prophets. Described.
Things below are recipient forms of life through degrees even to the ultimate, which is the body.
They place life in the body (and thus lose their intuition of such a subject). AC 6317.
When a man is in this (sensuous) lumen, his thought... is almost in the body...
(These corporeal Spirits) seem to themselves to be completely in the body.
No one can be delivered from Hell, unless he has been in spiritual good in the life of the body...

They believe that nothing lives with man but his body... and that unless he receives his body again he cannot rise. If they are told that there is an interior man who lives in the body, and who is resuscitated when the body dies, and that this man has a body like that of Spirits...
Under Bless, see this reference.
The head = interior things, the neck, what is intermediate, the body exterior, and the feet outermost things.
As all interior things are together in the ultimate, there is an appearance that life is... in the body.
(The soul... forming the body in the womb.)
Hence an Angel or man is such as his love is, and this not only in his organic beginnings in the brain, but also in the whole body, for the body is nothing but an organ derived from its beginnings.
The fallacy that man's life is of the body, when yet it is of the spirit in the body. Explained.

The inhabitants of Mercury have more slender bodies than the men of our Earth... That they think little about their bodies (is evident from the fact) that in the other life they do not want to appear as men... but as crystal globes.
The things which flow in from the Lord, flow in through the interiors... even into the Sensual, and through this into what is of the body.

The Spirits of the planet Mars had known while in the world that they were spirits clothed with a body, and as they have thought but little about their bodies, but only about the life of the spirit in the body, when they come into the other life they hardly know that their state of life is altered... SE 3251.

(The inhabitants of Jupiter) do not prepare food for taste, but for use... It was said that this would be well for man, for thus his heart would be set on having a sound mind in a sound body. It is not so with those with whom the taste rules. From this the body is sickly, at the least it is languid inwardly, consequently the mind is so, for this acts according to the state of the recipient parts which are of the body... Hence comes dullness in matters of thought and judgment, and quickness in those of the body and the world.
All who are regenerated are vivified from the Lord's proprium, which is His flesh, and body, and is Divine good itself.
(Truths are to good) as a garment is to the body, and as the body is to the soul.
The Spirits of our Earth relate to the various functions of the exterior parts of the body...
The wings covered their bodies () = that Divine truth was a covering to Divine good...
(In Saturn) they make, nothing of their bodies, except for the sake of life... therefore they do not inter the bodies of the dead, but cast them out, and cover them with boughs of forest trees.
If he came in his body () = truth without delight. Body = truth alone... for the body means the servant alone without a woman. AC 8978. AC 8984.
The more a man acts from the body the less he acts from reason, for the body is in the world, thus far from Heaven, where genuine reason is.

(The ancients) thought in the spirit almost abstractedly from the body; but the moderns... think in the body almost abstractedly from the spirit... The communication of Heaven is with the inward man when he can be withdrawn from the body...
Good is to truth as the body to the arms and feet; and in birds, to the wings... for by these the body moves itself. The body also = good.
This light will be extinguished with all those who have not distinct Knowledge of those things which are in the human body...
(Correspondence of the reticular forms of the body.)
That which is outermost not only contains interior things, but they cease in it, as in the human body.
The body = the good of celestial love, and also the good of spiritual love, and its external = truth from that good. Hence His body appeared as a beryl ().
The head corresponds to the celestial, and the body to the spiritual kingdom.
Successive things are not continuous, but discrete... Hence man can be withdrawn from the body and think in his spirit...

These things signify His Divine life in the Sensual, which is the life proper to the body; and also the resurrection of the latter. That the Lord rose with the whole body which He had in the world, differently from other men... AC 10738:5. AC 10825. AC 10826. HH 316, Explained. DLord 35:9. DLW 221:2. TCR 109. (See also TCR 170:2. Ath 192.)
The whole man from head to heel, inwardly and outwardly, is nothing but his own truth or falsity, and his own good or evil, and the body is the outward form of them.
The human body is the proceeding from the being of the father, which is called his soul.
Everything of the body corresponds to (the will and the understanding). Explained.
(The Spirits of the third Earth) are unwilling to think at all about their bodies...

I asked them whether they had had such an idea about their bodies when they lived in the world. They said that the men of their earth make nothing of their bodies, but only of the spirit in the body, because they know that the spirit will live to eternity, and that the body will perish. But they do not call the face the body... SE 547. SE 1668.
The face corresponds to what is of the inward man, and the body to what is of the outward.
The Lord's body, or flesh = the good of love.
Truth without good is like a body without life, and good without truth is like life without a body.
This external is what is called the body. NJHD 224.

He is then a man as to everything, except that he is not encompassed with that gross body with which he was in the world. This he leaves behind when he dies, and never resumes it. HH 75. HH 461, General article.
The manifesting of life is called the body.
The body is the instrumental through which the will acts...
Such as the life is, thus such as the love is, such is the whole man as to the soul and as to the body.
It is the spirit which lives in the body, and not the body from itself; and it is the spirit of everyone from which the body has its human form.
I have sometimes... asked Spirits whether they would like to be reinvested with their earthly bodies... At the mere idea... they fled far away...
The manifesting of life thence is what is called the body; hence the body is the likeness of its own soul... Hence it is evident what was the quality of the Lord's body, or Human...
Therefore the body does nothing of itself...
All things of the animal body are correspondences.
Under Obsess, see this reference.
They are in a body as before...
Amazed when they find they are in a body...
The reason the mind is not so wise in the world, is that it is in an earthly body...

The state of little children there is far before that of little children in the world, for they are not invested with an earthly body, but with one like what the Angels have. In itself the earthly body is heavy; it does not receive its first sensations and motions from the Spiritual World, but from the natural...
What nourishes their minds also nourishes their bodies... for the form of the body is nothing but the outward form of the interiors.
The body of every Spirit and Angel is the outward form of his love exactly corresponding to the inward form of his mind...

True marriage love... thence descends into the body, and is there felt as love; for whatever is perceived and felt in the body derives its origin from its Spiritual... Whatever descends from the spiritual man into the body presents itself there under another form, yet is similar and unanimous as are the soul and the body, or the cause and the effect.
The body does not think, because it is material... It is the spirit which thinks in the body... The body merely serves it, as an instrument...
Some think in their cold bodies...
The spirit remains in the body... until the total stoppage of the heart...
(The drawing of the spirit out of the body.)

Man is man from his spirit, and not from his body; the corporeal form is added to the spirit according to its form, and not the reverse, for the spirit is clothed with a body according to its own form; wherefore the spirit acts into the minutest particulars of the body...
Man there is in a body as in the world, in appearance there is no difference... But his body is spiritual.
Every particular of thought and will... is inscribed on the whole body...
The spiritual body, or body of man's spirit... is formed from those things which the man does from love or will.
They need only to cast off natural defilements with the body, and are immediately carried into Heaven.
The exteriors which belong to the body are separated after death, and those which adhere to the spirit are laid asleep...
(Such) are in truths and goods only as to the body.
The quality of a Spirit is known not only from his face, but from his body...
The bodies (of the infernals) are monstrous.
When the spirit is loosed from the body...
The earthly body is only an instrument...
Man is then in a spiritual body. LJCont 3:end.
No man can be in Heaven or Hell with the natural body, wherefore he must put off his natural body, and then be judged in a spiritual body.
Before spiritual (beings) the spiritual body appears the same as a natural body before natural.
As His body was now not material, but substantial, He came when the doors were shut, etc.
Love is... the general life of the whole body.
The soul cannot exist without its body, nor the body without its soul... The Divine body is what is meant by the Divine manifesting.
Every soul of man is in a spiritual body after it has cast off the material coverings...
As God is a man He has a body, and everything belonging to the body. Enumerated.

As it is in the body politic, so it is in the body spiritual. The body spiritual is the Church; its head is God Man. Hence (if several gods be thought of) the Church would appear as one body with several heads. DLW 25. Explained.
The bodies of men cannot exist and subsist unless they are under both suns; not so the bodies of Angels, which are spiritual.
That love and wisdom may make one... there are pairs in all things of the body.
All the interiors of both mind and body of the Angels are turned to the Lord as a Sun. General article.
Hence the body is a form corresponding to the understanding and will... and the form of the body corresponds to that of the understanding and will.
Under Atmosphere, see this reference.

The living forces in man are what inwardly constitute his body, in all of which there are motor fibres woven together in various ways... Thus the interior things of the will and understanding make the first degree, the interior things of the body make the second, and the whole body, which is the complex of them, the third. The interior things of the mind are in no power except through the forces in the body, and the forces are not in power except through the action of the body itself... The interior things of the mind correspond to the interior things of the body, and the interior things of the body to its exterior things... wherefore the two prior degrees are in power through the exteriors of the body...
As the whole, or body, has determined its powers chiefly into the arms and hands...

The natural substances of the (natural) mind which recede by death constitute the cutaneous covering of the spiritual body in which Angels and Spirits are. Through such covering, which is taken from the natural world, their spiritual bodies subsist.
All things in which a man confirms himself... come to be of his whole body...
An evil Spirit cannot gyrate his body from left to right, but from right to left; whereas a good Spirit can with difficulty gyrate his body from right to left, but with ease from left to right.
The descent of these degrees is toward the body.
(The Lord's) human body cannot be thought of as great or small, or of any stature...
Under Sphere, see this reference.

Mediate ends... look to these three things of man, his body, his Rational, and his Spiritual... A man cannot be conjoined with the Lord unless he is spiritual, he cannot be spiritual unless he is rational, and he cannot be rational unless his body is in a sound state. These things are like a house, of which the body is the foundation...
Uses for sustaining the body. Enumerated.
The Angels have a body, a Rational, and a Spiritual.
In everything spiritual there is an effort to clothe itself with a body.
The will and understanding... are in the brains... and therefore in the whole and every part of the body. General article.
Man's life in its beginnings is in the brains and in its derivatives in the body. General article. DLW 369, Explained.
The whole, which is the brain and the body together, originally consists of nothing but fibres which proceed from their beginnings in the brains.

From head to heel, or from the first principles in the head to the ultimates in the body, a man is such as his love is... When the love (of Spirits) is much attacked they disappear... This takes place because their bodies make one with their minds... The body is the external of the mind which feels and acts, thus they are one, and not two.
(The formation of the body through the blood.)
All things of the body relate to the heart and lungs. General article.
Correspondence of all things of the mind with all things of the body. General article.
It is the same in the whole body (as with the heavenly marriage of the heart and lungs).
The body is the external through which the mind or spirit feels and acts in its world. General article.

The will and understanding are in beginnings in the brains and in derivatives in the body, thus are all things of man as to their forms... Therefore the mind actuates the body... and the body is the mere obedience of its mind and does not do, from obedience, what the mind wills, for thus they would be two...
The conjunction of the spirit with the body is through the correspondence of the will and understanding with the heart and lungs, and their disjunction is through non-correspondence. General article.
The pulse and breathing of the spirit flow into those of the body, and produce them.

Death ensues when the body comes into such a state... that it cannot act in unison with its spirit... The life of the body depends on the correspondence of its pulse and breathing with those of the spirit; and when this correspondence ceases, so does the life of the body... Most are in the Spiritual World after being two days out of the body.

Spirits and Angels... all say that they possess a body as much as men in the world, but a spiritual one, and that they feel the beating of the heart and pulse at the wrist... SE 1715. SE 2917. SE 2985. SE 3157.
Hence the subsidiary life of the body depends on the heart alone...
Thus all things of the body come forth from the heart through the arteries and veins.

The will is the whole man as to the very form... and prepares all things in its house, which is the universal body... so that everything of the body is under obedience to the understanding as well as under obedience to the will. (Explained from anatomy.) DLW 408, Fully Explained.
What the body does... is only an effect from the internal and external of the spirit, for the body is mere obedience. AE 98.
If they do not come into the act of the body, still they are in act when there is consent, for they are then (in simultaneous order) in the body...

Concupiscences enter the body through the external of thought, wherefore when there is consent in the external of thought, they are at once in the body; the delight which is felt is there. That as is the mind so is the body, References. DP 199.
After death he has cast off the coverings which made up his body in the world.

External things are so connected with internal that in every operation they make one. This shall be illustrated... from the human body, in the whole and every part of which there are external and internal things. (Enumerated, and special examples given.)
(If a man knew the interior operations of the body he would pervert them. Enumerated.)
The infinite things there are in the body, Enumerated.

Man first puts on the grosser things of nature; his body is from these; but through death he puts them off, and retains the purer things of nature... This is effected through the rejection of temporary and natural ultimates, which is the death of the body.
Man then puts off the material body, and puts on the spiritual one.
In order for man to live to eternity, that which is mortal with him is taken away. The mortal with him is his material body, which is taken away through its death.

Usually on the third day after the heart has ceased to beat (they revive as to the spirit) and appear to themselves in a like body... so that they do not know they are not in the former world; yet they are not in a material body, but in a spiritual body, which appears as if it were material to the senses of those who also are spiritual.
They who constitute the body (of the Grand Man) with all its members (are signified by the great multitude.)
The bodies of the two witnesses () = the two essentials of the New Church... AR 506.

Bodies and souls of men () = goods and truths of the sense of the letter of the Word; for these = the same as the body and blood in the Holy Supper; body the Lord's Divine good, and blood His Divine truth; and as they signify these things, they also signify the Divine good and truth of the Word.
